main.description: Start a QR login: a browser that has made an OAuth pushed authorization request asks for a code that the Streamplace app, already signed in to this node, can scan and approve. The browser's user agent and IP address are recorded to show the approver.

requestUri.description: The request_uri the node's OAuth server returned for the browser's pushed authorization request.

id.description: Identifies this login attempt to getQRLogin and completeQRLogin.

url.description: What the QR code encodes: the attempt's approval page, which the app opens.

errors.name: QRLoginUnavailable
errors.description: This node has no Streamplace app configured to approve QR logins.
